scope: Validate PR #16 only against its exact Founder-approved candidate.
After activation and runner qualification, govern restoration of the approved 11-path candidate.

term.starts: Only when the separate activation record is reviewed and committed after the authority PR has merged.
term.expiry_rule: One calendar month after the recorded activation timestamp.

execution.objective: Safely qualify the verified-feature runner and restore the Founder-approved dashboard candidate without changing unrelated repository state.
activation_requirements: The authority PR must receive steward approval for its exact head and be merged by the Founder.
That merge alone leaves WCS-005 inactive.
A separate activation record must be reviewed and committed with the actual activation timestamp and exact one-calendar-month expiry.
WCS-005 must not be treated as active before that activation record is committed.
The runner must reject expired authority and have regression tests for expiry before any restoration or manifest rebinding.

limits: No database writes or record edits.
Stop and record NOT_RUN if an isolated preview cannot be run without publishing or deploying.

runner_fixes: Enforce activation and expiry before governed operations.
Separate isolated-preview validation from restoration-only candidate bindings.
Require PR #16 to remain OPEN and its head to match the exact approved candidate at validation and immediately before preview launch.
Clean up only temporary resources created by this runner; never run global git worktree prune.
required_checks: Compare TypeScript diagnostics for the exact target baseline and restored candidate; reject newly introduced errors.
Run the browser check only against an isolated preview of the exact approved candidate; otherwise record NOT_RUN_CANDIDATE_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE.
execution.target_baseline_rule: At authorized runner invocation, bind the restoration target to the then-current origin/main SHA and record it in the manifest.
invariants: No restoration, manifest rebinding, or preview execution before WCS-005 activation and applicable runner qualification.
No database writes, record edits, publication, or deployment.
Do not merge PR #16 or the restoration PR.
No application changes outside the exact 11-path candidate list.
Founder runtime verification is required before any separate release decision.

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: FOUNDER_VERIFIED or FOUNDER_REJECTED before any separate release decision.
